scope: One cache-only exploratory reused-TRAIN LOGO comparison; not independent validation or a release
novelty: Discriminatively fitted regularized affine boundary on the same frozen XCLIP ordered features; previous cosine margin was already supervised and linear
supervision: One nearest cached PTS-window per positive point; all windows in negative videos; other positive windows excluded from fit
weights: unique_train_video_count / (2 * class_train_video_count * selected_windows_in_video); identical weights for scaler and classifier
pooling: max; same cached windows and PTS grid as ordered_max baseline; first maximum on ties
point_gate: No regression in candidate-point MAE on all positive videos and paired common true positives; neither is semantic event/evidence validation
known_library_warning: Installed sklearn1.6.1 supplies the removed scipy iprint verbosity option; this OptimizeWarning does not change the frozen solver. ConvergenceWarning still fails the run
limits: Repeated research on TRAIN; automatic groups lack expert validation
Official points are not exhaustive action boundaries
No type, rule, multi-event or evidence relevance validation
Cache-only CPU fit/predict cost excludes decoding, encoder inference and upload
No TUNE/HOLDOUT evaluation; no new GPU inference, media reads or annotations
No hyperparameter, threshold, pooling or seed search
